intent: Reconstruct pre-migration source plus correctness-only patches, measure it, then gate each optional capability independently.

changes.subject: Migrate upstream 0.3.4 overflow predicates and quantified theory certification
correctness_obligations: Reject invalid numeric literals; certify quantified regions and discover ground datatype obligations.

changes.subject: Migrate upstream array discovery and SMT-LIB symbol handling
correctness_obligations: Discover nested array reads and store congruence; prevent internal-symbol capture; preserve source spelling and quoted symbols.

changes.subject: Migrate upstream allocator alignment fixes and enforce handle ownership
correctness_obligations: Allocator alignment, zero-sized allocations, handle ownership and lifetime safety.

changes.subject: Migrate datatype construction and close set/model integration gaps
correctness_obligations: Constructor disjointness/injectivity and iterative folding; correct declaration interner; set congruence and cyclic model reads.

changes.subject: Migrate permanent SAT clauses and preserve restored obligations across scopes
correctness_obligations: Restore eliminated clauses across scopes and retain permanent clauses and valid proof reasons.

changes.subject: Migrate persistent BV definitions and sound scoped assumption search
correctness_obligations: Preserve assumptions over restarts, scoped BV definitions, selector explanations and assignment rollback.

changes.subject: Migrate query-wide SAT and embedded bit-vector resource budgets
correctness_obligations: Enforce query-wide conflict/decision/embedded-check budgets without accepting interrupted search.

changes.subject: Migrate explained BV/EUF exchange and joint model validation
correctness_obligations: Explain cross-theory BV equalities and independently validate the joint BV/EUF assignment.

changes.subject: Migrate nested array and finite theory interfaces
correctness_obligations: Ground nested-array/BV interfaces, Boolean term-position polarity, and arithmetic array arrangements. Numeric UF pins are replaced by fail-closed final-value consistency.

changes.subject: Isolate generated symbols and expose refinement diagnostics
correctness_obligations: Prevent source names capturing generated skolems and other internal symbols; retain model/seed enumeration helpers used by correctness code.

changes.subject: Preserve ground finite domains for quantified functions
correctness_obligations: Do not waive finite ground BV domains when the same function also occurs under quantifiers.

changes.subject: Migrate complete quantifier positions and finite expansion
correctness_obligations: Quantifier-position ownership, capture-free binder rows, exact distinct certification; complete small finite domains fix published models violating quantified assertions.

changes.subject: Preserve array ITE identities and import facade terms safely
correctness_obligations: Enforce array ITE branch identity; import facade terms between independent arenas, retaining scope/core identity.

changes.subject: Migrate exact BV values into the shared model evaluator
correctness_obligations: Evaluate published BV values exactly at arbitrary width and Boolean conditions through their circuit assignments.

changes.subject: Migrate certified array completion and structural model reads
correctness_obligations: Retain structural array/model value evaluation and independent validity certificates. Remove speculative array interpretation search.

changes.subject: Migrate certified model publication and exact completion from upstream 0.3.4
correctness_obligations: Retain exact published-interpretation validation, witness hygiene, real solver-candidate reconstruction, ANIA and model-state fixes. Remove new alternative-model proposal searches.

changes.subject: Migrate guarded datatype refinement and preserve exact nonlinear witnesses
correctness_obligations: Datatype congruence/occurs checks; preserve exact NIRA witnesses; respect assertion polarity and exact scalar sorts.

changes.subject: Migrate bounded guard-boundary counterexample proposals
Migrate standalone literal formal obligations with explicit verifier setup
Migrate robustness changes and validate CAD cache and optimizer results
correctness_obligations: Checked state access and error propagation; complete CAD cache keys; verify PMRES objective and result before claiming optimality.

changes.subject: Replace algebraic extension placeholders with exact quotient arithmetic
correctness_obligations: Replace false algebraic field defaults with exact quotient arithmetic and valid cache identity.

changes.subject: Migrate exact finite-array cardinality and extensionality domains
Migrate bounded exact datatype model separation from upstream 0.3.4
correctness_obligations: Retain pinned-field and exact-offset validation; retain the pre-migration one-proposal separation policy.

changes.subject: Migrate exact function consistency and compound datatype field models
correctness_obligations: Retain exact compound-field evaluation and guarded collision detection; replace the added general-function retry loops with rejection of conflicting candidates.

changes.subject: Migrate upstream model interfaces and keep finite-field completion in range
correctness_obligations: Fix to_real result sort, malformed distinct handling, finite-field model ranges, and reject unjustified set choices.

changes.subject: Complete generated datatype models and restore rejected repair snapshots
correctness_obligations: Generated datatype witness obligations; rollback unsuccessful repair snapshots and default markers; exact offset arithmetic.

changes.subject: Migrate upstream differential tools and complete the 0.3.4 capability audit

numeric_uf_pins.decision: drop eager numeric UF pins; retain array/quantified purifier pins and final value consistency
numeric_uf_pins.evidence: Prior 10 common seeds plus fresh replay isolate 11.19348x and 4.29175x treatment/null instruction cost on the two affected UFLIA instances. No new heuristic is introduced by rejecting an unverified candidate.
